sites.name: Tran Bien Temple of Literature
sites.event: The first Temple of Literature built in Dang Trong (in 1715), symbolizing the tradition of studiousness and culture of the Bien Hoa - Dong Nai region.

sites.name: Cat Tien National Park
sites.event: A UNESCO-recognized World Biosphere Reserve, which preserved the one-horned rhinoceros (formerly) and a tropical rainforest ecosystem.

place.commune: Nam Cat Tien Commune (and neighboring communes)

sites.name: War Zone D
sites.event: A famous revolutionary base, the 'secret zone' of the Southeast region during the two resistance wars against the French and the Americans.

place.commune: Ma Da Commune, Hieu Liem Commune

sites.name: Buu Long Tourist Area
sites.event: Known as the 'miniature Ha Long Bay' of the South, featuring Long An Lake and cliffs reflecting on the water.

sites.name: Hang Gon Megalithic Tomb
sites.event: A special national relic, the largest ancient stone tomb (Dolmen) in Vietnam and Southeast Asia, dating back to around 150 BC.

sites.name: Chua Chan Mountain (Gia Lao Mountain)
sites.event: The second highest mountain in the Southeast region (after Ba Den Mountain), famous for Buu Quang Pagoda and the three-root, single-canopy banyan tree.

sites.name: That Phu Ancient Temple (Ong Pagoda)
sites.event: The oldest Chinese pagoda in the Southern region (1684), associated with the Chinese community and the reclamation of the Bien Hoa region.

sites.name: Tri An Lake
sites.event: A giant artificial lake serving the Tri An Hydropower Plant, a popular spot for camping and SUP paddling.

sites.name: Tan Trieu Pomelo Village
sites.event: A long-standing traditional pomelo-growing craft village, established in the 19th century, famous for the 'duong la cam' pomelo variety.

sites.name: Cat Tien Archaeological Site (Cat Tien Sanctuary)
sites.event: A large-scale complex of temple ruins, proving the existence of an ancient civilization (influenced by Brahmanism) on the banks of the Dong Nai River.

sites.name: Mai Waterfall - Bau Nuoc Soi Hot Spring
sites.event: A primeval forest eco-tourism area, famous for its beautiful waterfall and natural hot mineral spring.
